about.heading: About Écono Électro
about.intro: Écono Électro Services is your trusted destination in Laval for quality appliances at affordable prices.
story: We are proud to serve our community with a wide selection of refrigerators, ranges, washers, dryers and appliance sets. Our goal is simple: to help families and businesses find reliable appliances that respect their budget.
With the opening of our second location, we are even closer to our customers and offer the same warm service, the best prices and a shopping experience focused on your satisfaction.
At Écono Électro, we believe every customer deserves honest service, quality products and an excellent shopping experience.
about.mission: To make quality appliances affordable, accessible and easy to find for every customer. We take the time to understand your needs so we can help you find the appliances that suit your home and your budget.
about.vision: To become a trusted reference in appliances by making quality products, fair prices and exceptional service accessible to everyone. Better appliances. Better prices. Happier customers.
